video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows on one scatter chart how k-means clustering sorts a cafe's customers into three groups

shop_draw.what: The outline of a small cafe shopfront draws itself, then fills with soft color

camera_tilt_down.what: The camera moves down from the shopfront to the empty chart below it

dot_fall.what: A customer dot that has come out of the shop door travels along a curved path to its place on the chart

dot_trail_fade.what: The purple path behind a dot disappears once the dot has landed

axes_draw.what: The two chart axes draw themselves outward from the corner

tick_numbers_enter.what: The numbers along both axes and the faint grid lines fade in one after another

axis_titles_reveal.what: The two axis titles are revealed from left to right by a moving edge

camera_push_in.what: The camera moves a little closer to the part of the chart being explained, then later moves back to show the whole chart

badge_enter.what: A small label card fades in and rises into place on the chart

badge_exit.what: The small label card fades away

guide_lines_draw.what: Two violet guide lines grow from one customer dot to its values on the two axes

guide_lines_exit.what: The two violet guide lines fade away

tick_highlight.what: The axis number the guide line points at turns from navy to violet

lasso_draw.what: A violet lasso line draws most of a loop around one area of dots

lasso_unwind.what: The violet lasso line unwinds and disappears

question_mark_enter.what: A large violet question mark fades in and rises into place on the chart

question_mark_exit.what: The question mark fades away as the center markers come out of it

center_markers_fly_out.what: Three large center markers appear at the question mark, one after another, and each fades in while gliding to its starting spot on the chart

measure_lines_draw.what: Three measuring lines grow from one dot to the three center markers

shortest_line_highlight.what: The shortest measuring line turns from navy to violet and becomes thicker

measure_lines_retract.what: The two longer measuring lines shrink back into the dot and disappear

dot_join_line.what: A violet line grows from a dot to its nearest center marker, one dot after another across the chart

dot_shape_change.what: A dot stays in place and changes its shape and color to match its center: navy circle, violet square or outlined triangle

center_jump.what: A center marker slides across the chart to the middle of its own dots, and the lines to its dots stay attached

trail_follow.what: A dashed navy line stretches out behind the sliding center marker from the spot where it started

old_spot_ring_enter.what: A small navy ring fades in at the spot a center marker has just left

trail_exit.what: The dashed trail and the ring at the old spot fade away before the next jump

near_lines_exit.what: The violet lines between dots and centers fade away

switch_line_emphasis.what: The lines of the dots that are about to switch become thicker and fully violet

line_swing.what: The line of a switching dot swings from its old center marker across to the center that is now nearer

switch_ring_pulse.what: A violet ring expands at a steady speed from a dot that switches groups and fades as it grows

center_jump_repeat.what: In later rounds each center marker slides a shorter distance to the new middle of its dots

counter_arrows_spin.what: Two small arrows chase each other in a circle beside the round counter, turning continuously

counter_arrows_stop.what: The two circling arrows fade away once no dot switches

check_draw.what: A violet check mark draws itself in the counter card

counter_text_swap.what: The words no changes fade in inside the counter card in place of the round number

center_calm_glow.what: The soft glow behind each center marker brightens once and settles while the marker stays still

group_outline_draw.what: An outline in the group's own color draws itself around each group of dots

group_outline_pulse.what: A group's outline briefly becomes thicker and returns as that group is named

camera_pull_back.what: The camera moves back so the shopfront above the chart comes into view again

offer_card_travel.what: A small offer card travels from the shop door along a violet curved path that draws behind it to one group of dots

offer_icon_enter.what: The group's shape fades in on the offer card after it arrives

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind an invisible edge

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out at the end of its scene

subtitle_words.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as the narrator says them

world_fade_out.what: The whole chart scene fades away before the logo appears

markers_gather.what: The three center markers and one dot, now four rounded violet blocks, slide together into a row

logo_bars_grow.what: Four logo bars grow upward from a baseline one after another, left to right

logo_wordmark_reveal.what: The brand name is revealed left to right by a moving edge

logo_glow.what: The logo bars glow brighter, then settle to a soft glow

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises into place under the logo

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises into place

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow on the button slides a little to the right once
